parameters.command:
={{ "mkdir -p /data/assistant-memory/inbox/raw && cat > /data/assistant-memory/inbox/raw/" + $json.slug + ".md <<'EOF'
# Memory Capture

- Captured at: " + $json.stamp + "
- Source: " + $json.source + "

## Raw Note

" + $json.note + "
EOF" }}

={{ "mkdir -p /data/assistant-memory/memory /data/assistant-memory/inbox/processed && cat >> /data/assistant-memory/memory/" + $json.safeFile + " <<'EOF'
" + $json.appendix + "
EOF
" + "cat > /data/assistant-memory/inbox/processed/" + $json.slug + ".md <<'EOF'
# Processed Memory Capture

- Captured at: " + $json.stamp + "
- Source: " + $json.source + "
- Target file: " + $json.safeFile + "

" + $json.response + "
EOF" }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', captured_at: $node['Prepare Memory Update'].json.stamp, target_file: $node['Prepare Memory Update'].json.safeFile, embeddings_refreshed: true }) }}
